headline: Espaçolaser Sells Three Commercial Stores to Franchisees
summary: Espaçolaser announced the sale of three commercial store units to network franchisees as part of its operational restructuring.
why: Franchise asset transactions alter corporate revenue streams by shifting company-owned units to franchised models.

impacts.name: Espaçolaser SA
impacts.why: Divesting locations to franchisees reorganizes operational footprint and capital expenditure.
